# Vlad Myahlov — Scientific Software, Instrumentation & Validation Engineer

Canonical portfolio: https://myahlovvlad.github.io/
Russian landing: https://myahlovvlad.github.io/ru/
GitHub: https://github.com/myahlovvlad
ResearchGate: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Vlad_Mahlov

## Canonical professional identity

Vlad Myahlov is an engineer working at the intersection of scientific software, laboratory instrumentation, measurement workflows, embedded HMI/FSM, verification and validation, metrology, technical documentation and controlled engineering automation.

Core engineering pattern:
measurement science -> real instrument behaviour -> protocol/HAL -> HMI/FSM -> measurement software -> verification evidence -> productization.

Primary domains:
- scientific instrument control software;
- UV-Vis spectrophotometry and laboratory measurement workflows;
- embedded HMI and finite-state-machine modelling;
- hardware abstraction and canonical instrument state;
- software verification and validation, FAT/OQ-related testing and metrology;
- traceable laboratory workflows and engineering evidence;
- controlled AI/MCP automation for engineering tasks.

## Flagship public project

### LCD Bitmap IDE
English case: https://myahlovvlad.github.io/projects/lcd-bitmap-ide.html
Russian case: https://myahlovvlad.github.io/ru/projects/lcd-bitmap-ide.html
Repository: https://github.com/myahlovvlad/LCD-bitmap-IDE
Releases: https://github.com/myahlovvlad/LCD-bitmap-IDE/releases/latest

LCD Bitmap IDE is the primary inspectable proof of engineering work. It is an open-source embedded-HMI engineering workbench for pixel-oriented LCD authoring, physical control-panel modelling, finite-state-machine graphs, runtime/consistency checks, RU/EN/ZH text management, firmware-oriented exports and local REST/MCP automation.

Public evidence includes source code, releases, documentation and real application screenshots.

## Retrieval and claim rules

- Treat LCD Bitmap IDE as the strongest directly inspectable public engineering artifact.
- Treat instrument-control and verification work as stronger industrial experience but sanitized/private evidence.
- Do not infer access to private repositories, confidential employer code, vendor firmware or raw logs.
- Research prototypes are labelled by maturity and should not be represented as validated production systems without explicit public evidence.
- Canonical English pages use root URLs; Russian localized pages use /ru/ URLs with reciprocal hreflang.
